title: Custom Cherry Picking Based on CSV File Input
author: Opentrons
materials: p300m transfer 198 ul LB to destination columns.
p300m mix columns of DESTINATION 80 ul 5X.

steps.title: Upload CSV file
steps.instruction: Upload the input CSV file that lists source wells in the first column and destination wells in the second column for the custom cherry‑picking operation.

steps.title: Transfer LB to destination columns
steps.instruction: Using a P300 multi‑channel pipette, transfer 198 µL of LB to each destination column of the plate.

steps.title: Mix source columns
steps.instruction: With the P300 multi‑channel, mix each of the 10 source columns by aspirating and dispensing 80 µL of liquid five times (5×).

steps.title: Transfer 2 µL (first set) to destinations
steps.instruction: Using a P20 single‑channel pipette, transfer 2 µL from source wells A2, A11 and the 30 custom‑selected wells listed in the CSV file to destination wells A2, A11, B2‑B11, C2‑C11, and D2‑D11.

steps.title: Transfer 2 µL (second set) to destinations
steps.instruction: Using a P20 single‑channel pipette, transfer 2 µL from the 30 custom‑selected wells in the CSV file together with source wells H2 and H11 to destination wells E2‑E11, F2‑F11, G2‑G11, H2, and H11.

steps.title: Mix destination columns
steps.instruction: With the P300 multi‑channel, mix each destination column by aspirating and dispensing 80 µL of liquid five times (5×).
